title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts

description:
Author record for Emmy Noether in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record keeps earlier broad working readers while a paper-by-paper source-and-translation edition replaces them.

Status at a glance. [##########] numbered-paper stream: Papers 1-43 complete and audited in paired original German and English readers; [##########] source-scan witnesses, TeX, audit material, and build reports preserved; [#---------] multilingual pilot layer: Paper 01 available in Spanish, Japanese, and French with TeX/witness sources.

Latest update. Adds Paper 01 pilot translations in Spanish, Japanese, and French as supplemental readers and a compact TeX/witness ZIP, while preserving the audited German/English numbered-paper cumulative readers.
